subgoals: Measure the tail area at least as extreme
Double the tail for a two-sided test

visual.title: The tail beyond the observation
visual.caption: The p-value is the area at least as extreme as the observed statistic under the null. For a two-sided test both tails count, so the same distance on the other side is included.

predict.question: The observed statistic is 2.5. What is the two-sided p-value?
predict.explain: The upper tail beyond 2.5 is about 0.0062. A two-sided test doubles it, so p is about 0.0124.
